_about: Ground-truth diagnoses for real Atmosphère crash logs from one user's Switch (Smash Ultimate 13.0.5, AMS 1.12.1, FW 23.0.1) on 2026-11-05. File names are '<unix_seconds>_<program_id>.log' (Atmosphère's own naming, minus an upload prefix). 'rule' is the rule ID the explainer should match. Times are UTC.

logs.explanation: Not Smash. hbloader (homebrew menu) app 'appstore' crashed. Outdated HB App Store build; replace it or use sphaira.
Not Smash. Themezer-NX crashed (its server is gone). Delete it.
Old NX-Shell build incompatible with current firmware.

Result 2002-4802, User Break in nn::diag::Abort called from nn::fs::OpenFile, return address in libparam_config + 0x1ec44. Param Config failed to open a file under ultimate/mods (stack contains 'mate/mod' = 'ultimate/mods' fragment). Root cause in this case: disabled (dot-prefixed) and broken mod folders left inside mods/ (incl. a corrupted 'Bandana Dee' entry that showed up as a file). Fix: keep unused mods OUTSIDE mods/ (e.g. mods_all/), remove broken entries.

Data Abort at address 0x69, PC = Skyline + 0x4c58, LR = Skyline + 0x4bbc. Skyline's patch-verify reads 8 bytes for a 4-byte patch at main+0x3D3FFC (last 4 bytes of a page) and deliberately aborts when the next mirror page differs. Fix: patched Skyline subsdk9 (verify loads changed to 4-byte). Triggered when Smashline is installed.
Instruction Abort at address 0 with LR inside a loaded moveset module 'smashline_alucardssm' (the Alucard moveset's own code). The moveset itself crashed. Remove/update that moveset.

Result 2002-4802 abort from nn::fs::OpenFile called by arcropolis + 0x16f614. ARCropolis could not open a file inside a mod. In this case: CSK Collection's optional config folders active while the CSK plugin was missing, plus dotted folders inside mods/. Fix: run the folder scanner; move extras/disabled mods out.

logs.note: Taken with ARCropolis 4.0.10 instead of 4.1.1; same signature, proving ARCropolis version was not the cause.
Dotted (disabled) mods were still inside mods/; moving them to mods_all fixed it.

logs.fighter: pickel (Steve; originally noted as Piranha Plant, but Piranha Plant is packun)
logs.explanation: Mid-match crash, Data Abort at 0 on MainThread inside the game (cross2_Release.nss) while running vanilla Steve scripts (lua2cpp_pickel.nrs; pickel = Steve) through smashline_interpreter. No mods loaded. Likely a Smashline (2.0.0) issue with that fighter; report to Smashline with the log. Workaround: avoid that fighter.

Data Abort at a small address (0x5a), PC = smashline + 0x55d8 (UTF-8 validation), LR = smashline_clone_weapon + 0x340. Running Smashline 2.0.0 with a moveset built for Smashline <= 1.6.8 whose clone_weapon call uses the OLD argument layout (a weapon kind integer lands where 2.0 expects a string). Fix: use Smashline 1.6.8 for that moveset, or get a 2.0-updated version. Culprits in this run: old Blaze (2024), then Tetrimino.

logs.note: Only Blaze (old Sept-2024-era build / fire_|nolan version) in mods; confirmed culprit.

logs.explanation: Data Abort in nnSdk __memcpy_device + 0x1e8 with LR = arcropolis + 0x5c1f4 while loading mod files (stack fragment 'mate/mod'). Broken mod folder layout. Real cause found via file listing: the 'ultron' folder contained a stray nested '{Moveset} Shadow' folder (with a second copy of Shadow's plugin.nro + config.json) and was missing Ultron's own plugin.nro.

logs.note: Set included Tetrimino (calls smashline functions that exist in no public release) and other old-ABI movesets.
Only Tetrimino + Thwomp in mods; Thwomp does not call clone_weapon, so Tetrimino is the culprit.

logs.explanation: Data Abort at 0x5, PC = smashline + 0x540c, LR = smashline_clone_weapon + 0xa0 on Smashline 1.6.8. The reverse mismatch: a moveset built for Smashline 2.0 (new clone_weapon layout) running on 1.6.8; the name-string LENGTH (e.g. 5) is used as a pointer. Culprit: Herobrine (updated 2026-11-05). Fix: run that moveset with Smashline 2.0.0.

logs.note: Same as 22:46; the broken ultron folder was still present.

logs.explanation: Atmosphère DNS MITM startup log, not a crash report. The explainer should recognise and say so.
